_hand_fit: hand_fit 1 = fingers are solved as real joint chains every frame (your own finger lengths, real joint limits, wild points ignored), 0 = use the tracked points as they are. hand_fit_smooth = how steady fingers are while still (higher = steadier, slower to start moving). hand_fit_speed = how much movement it takes for that to let go. hand_fit_robust_mm = points further than this from the fitted finger count for less.
_interp: finger_interp 1 = fingers move smoothly between camera frames (about 20 ms extra finger delay), 0 = jump to each new frame. finger_interp_ms = how long each move takes, 0 = the measured time between frames (12-60 ms).
_share: share_with_controllers 0 = the tracked hands keep both hand slots from SteamVR start (so VRChat never gets the Frame controllers as simulated Oculus Touch controllers); 1 = give a slot to a Frame controller when no hand is seen (controller_idle_s / disconnect_s apply).
_sides: finger_aim_limits 1 = aimed fingers stay within real joint ranges. shape_sides = how clear the hand shape must be (0..1) before it decides left/right instead of the tracker label, once learned from your hands (0 = off). controller_idle_s = a Frame controller that moved this recently keeps its hand (0 = tracked hands always win). disconnect_s = a hand lost this long gives its slot back to the controller.
_frametop_030: Frametop 0.3.0+ on the headset: its hand points are already its fitted skeleton (your bone lengths, joint limits, filtered). ft_gestures 1 = pinch (trigger), thumb+middle pinch (B) and fist (grip) come from Frametop's own detector (model v20a) when it sends them, 0 = this driver's own checks. skeleton_finger_filter 1 = this driver also smooths the fingers on top of Frametop's skeleton, 0 = skip that second smoothing (quicker fingers, a little less steady).
_touch: Contact retargeting: when your real thumb tip touches a fingertip, the avatar's thumb is bent so its tips meet too (the avatar's fingers aren't your length, so copied angles alone miss). touch_retarget 1 = on, 0 = off. touch_near_mm = real tips this close count as touching (fingertip points sit 1-2 cm apart pad to pad), touch_far_mm = it starts blending in from this far. touch_pad_mm = gap left between the avatar's tips. touch_finger_share = how much the finger comes to meet the thumb (0 = only the thumb moves; ring and pinky come about twice as far).
_capture: capture_head_pose 1 = place hands with your head pose from when the headset cameras saw them (no swimming when you turn your head), 0 = head pose now. network_ms = Wi-Fi delay added to the frame age.
_help: Edit this file while VRChat is running. Changes are picked up within 1 second, no restart needed.
_wrist: metres in WORLD space - shifts change direction when you turn around, prefer the head and per-hand offsets
_head: metres relative to your head, both hands: x negative = left, y positive = up, z negative = forward
_left_right: extra per-hand offset relative to your head, same directions as above
_smooth: min_cutoff lower = steadier when still; beta higher = less lag on fast moves; smoothing 0 = off
_prediction: 0 to 1, how far ahead SteamVR predicts the hand; lower it if hands overshoot
_hold: milliseconds a hand stays in place after tracking drops before it disappears
_fingers: finger_mode 2 = every finger bone points where your real finger points (all directions), 1 = every joint follows your real finger by bend angles, 0 = old one-curl-per-finger; finger_aim_blend (mode 2) 1 = fully aimed, lower = mixed with mode 1 (steadier); finger_min_cutoff lower = steadier fingers
_gestures: 1 = pinch thumb+index for trigger, fist for grip, pinch thumb+middle for B/menu; 0 = off
_hand_offset: metres in the HAND's own frame, turns with your hand: x positive = toward thumb side, y positive = toward fingertips, z positive = out of the palm
_contact: contact_assist 1 = fingers touch when you pinch/make a fist, 0 = pure measured angles; thumb_mode 0 = thumb wraps like before, 1 = measured thumb bend (one axis), 2 = thumb follows your real thumb in every direction
_finger_point: finger smoothing, separate from the wrist: higher = freer and faster, lower = steadier
_calibrate: change the calibrate_curls number (e.g. 0 to 1), then open your hands fully and make tight fists for 6 seconds
